about: Expected runtime/formation failures, scoped to exact cases and lanes. Every uncovered failure fails scripts/cases.mjs. Entries with newly passing lanes must be removed. Retired positional-ABI fixtures were migrated to named fields in V1 without removing their default/setter observations; reflected-name fixtures now pass their explicit keep_function_names contracts.

entries.reason: Explicit unsupported ABI boundary: an ambiguous union of two undiscriminated product types is erased to JsValue, and generic bodies erase an abstract T to JsValue. No public decoder or runtime type witness is defined for these crossings; this remains a refusal, never an executable parity pass.
entries.owner: S4 public ABI scope decision (docs/migration/s4-public-abi.md); V1 records the refusal
